# non-matching: solid A-U with no gaps at all — every SIMD chunk's
# bitmask is all-ones, ctz always returns 0, so the skip loop can
# never advance more than one position. This is the input the
# density switch exists to rescue.






# matching: the same dense A-U filler with real <Letter>1:<body>
# records spliced in, so the match path runs under the same
# dense-first-byte conditions.
